Marta (Head of Product): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A 1 can leadership share a short, customer-friendly timeline for Hosted API streaming, Console cost visuals, and Optimize recommendations + the blockers we should call out?
Lee (VP Product): High level for customers: Hosted streaming -> target: late July (staged GA). Console cost visuals -> public beta mid-August, GA by end-September. Optimize recommendations -> invite-only beta Sept, broader beta Oct. All are "targets" pending gating checks.
Diego (Eng): Tech blockers: kernel-selection perf regressions (owner: Sanjay), and a KV-cache cold-start eviction race (owner: Maya). Both need canary validation.
Maya (Eng-Platform): I'll own the KV-cache fix and the canary monitoring. Plan: hotfix in next 2 sprints, then a 48h canary.
Rina (Optimize PM): Optimize gating: 30 days of stable metrics retention + privacy/legal signoff for cross-customer comparisons. I'll circulate the data-waiver for early access.
Samira (DevEx): Docs plan: publish "alpha" API surface now with clear "not GA" banner; migration guide when public beta opens. I'll coordinate SDK owners to freeze breaking changes during beta.
Nora (Sales): Customers on private infra need 30-45 days notice. Also request: make any client-facing changes optional with a documented deprecation path.
deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2026-06-28T02:00:00Z -> 2026-06-30T02:00:00Z, target: 2% opt-in traffic. Tracing + automatic rollback hooks enabled.
Diego (Eng): Canary details: opt-in pools only, we abort if p99 > 2x baseline or memory > +10% sustained. We'll include tracing spans to aid rollbacks.
Marta (Head of Product): Action items: Diego to open perf tickets + link PRs, Maya to own KV-cache canary + dashboards, Rina to send waiver + beta list, Samira to draft alpha docs & migration FAQ, Nora to prepare private-deploy notice templates. I'll assemble a one-page customer timeline by EOD Friday.
Lee (VP Product): One more: Marketing/sales should use month targets and include gating criteria. If canary fails we push dates. Keep external messaging conservative.
Samira (DevEx): I'll schedule a short "what's new" demo for beta customers and tag SDK maintainers in the release PRs.
Marta (Head of Product): Thanks all  I'll post the compiled timeline + action tracker in #product-followup when ready. :white_check_mark:
